test_cases.title: Customer Phone Number & OTP Login Flow
test_cases.description: Verify customer can enter phone number, request OTP, input verification code, and reach home screen.

test_cases.title: Category Navigation & Service Catalog Search
test_cases.description: Verify browsing service categories (AC Repair, Plumbing, Cleaning) and searching catalog items returns valid results.

test_cases.title: Service Option Selection & Cart Quantity Updates
test_cases.description: Verify selecting a service, configuring add-ons, adjusting item quantity, and viewing price total in cart.

test_cases.title: Service Location Address Selection & Geofence Verification
test_cases.description: Verify adding/selecting saved address and validating service availability in customer pin code.

test_cases.title: Promo Code Redemption & Discount Calculation
test_cases.description: Verify entering valid coupon code applies discount to bill summary and updates payable amount.

test_cases.title: Razorpay Online Payment & COD Checkout Selection
test_cases.description: Verify choosing Razorpay opens payment gateway modal and selecting COD places booking with pending status.

test_cases.title: Active Booking Lifecycle Tracking & OTP Display
test_cases.description: Verify active booking screen shows real-time status, assigned vendor details, and start/completion OTP.

test_cases.title: Booking Cancellation Flow & Reason Selection
test_cases.description: Verify opening cancel booking dialog, selecting cancellation reason, confirming cancellation, and viewing refund notice.

test_cases.title: Post-Service Rating & Feedback Submission
test_cases.description: Verify customer can submit star rating (1-5) and write feedback upon booking completion.
